verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official MCP server giving AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules, and policies (terraform-docs-10/23, terraform-probe-4/9), which supports AI-assisted workflows, but this is a context/protocol server rather than a built-in natural-language-to-HCL code generator in the toolchain itself. Missing for 10: no evidence of a native Terraform CLI/IDE feature that generates infrastructure code directly from natural language prompts, no hands-on demonstration of NL-to-code generation, and no documentation describing an AI code-authoring assistant shipped with Terraform.
